title: General Starbird leaves Johnston Island hours after Bluegill Triple Prime

tellings.quote: Operation Dominic. Ogle writes that General Starboard left Johnston Island at 4:00 a.m. the night of Operation Bluegill Triple Prime.

plain: In 1962, during Operation Dominic, a series of American nuclear tests in the Pacific, General Alfred Starbird left Johnston Island at 4 a.m. on the night of the Bluegill Triple Prime test. Michels says William Ogle wrote this, and he draws on the logs of the ship USS Summit County. Michels tells it himself as a hint that something unusual happened around that test.
